description: RETIRED (R8). is_supported_code is no longer private nor uses hardcoded matches! ranges; it now delegates to is_registered_numeric() which is public. TBL-011's original assumption (private function, test through from_str) is obsolete. The production fix makes is_supported_code() and is_registered_numeric() synonymous. R7 review F-R7 (Section 7) identified this as stale.
impact: N/A (retired). is_supported_code() now delegates to is_registered_numeric(), so from_str → is_supported_code() → is_registered_numeric() provides equivalent coverage. No need for separate API surface tracking.
compensating_evidence: REPAIR-7 production fix verified in R7 review. is_supported_code() at diagnostic.rs:1518 delegates to is_registered_numeric(). Kani mirror at kani_is_supported_code.rs:32 does same. No private-function assumption remaining.

description: R5: kani_serde_roundtrip.rs — deserialize_symbolic_code uses &'static str errors instead of String/format!() to avoid Kani allocator path explosion over 157-entry registry. The error type simplification does not change the proof claim (Err vs Ok discrimination).
impact: If production serde error messages convey diagnostic information beyond Err/Ok, this model reduction loses that fidelity. The proof only verifies that unregistered strings are rejected, not the exact error string.
compensating_evidence: Proptest PO-021 tests production serde with real error types; Kani proves the Err case exists.

description: R6→R8: iter().find() state-space explosion — vb_core Kani harnesses (PO-001, PO-002 H1/H3, PO-004 H1, PO-005, PO-008, PO-009 H1, PO-012 H1, PO-013, PO-014) block on Kani's symbolic execution of CODE_REGISTRY.iter().find() over 157 entries. Each find() call creates up to 157 unwind iterations; harness loops call find() up to 157 times → ~24,649 paths. memcmp in &str comparisons adds sub-loops. PO-004 H1 (all_constants) specifically has O(157²) path explosion. PO-004 H2/H3 resolved by REPAIR-8 (split + unwind fix).
impact: Cannot verify harnesses that call production symbol_to_numeric/numeric_to_symbolic/symbolic_code/from_str without redesign.
compensating_evidence: PO-004 H2: 3 sub-harnesses PASS (54-57s). PO-004 H3: accepts_ranges PASS (75.9s). PO-004 H1: proptest PO-018 compensates. 8 other harnesses PASS. Const-eval assertions provide compile-time guarantees.
expiry: When harnesses are redesigned with manual for loops or const-lookup
r8_update: PO-004 H2/H3 RESOLVED in REPAIR-8 (split harnesses + unwind 160). PO-004 H1 BLOCKED (157x157 = ~24,649 paths).

description: REPAIR-8: vb_yaml Cargo.toml now depends on vb_core (path dep). Required for Kani harness in vb_yaml/src/kani/kani_yaml_error_code.rs which calls vb_core::is_registered_symbolic(). description: REPAIR-9 (F-R8-001 PO-003 fix): Replaced model enum ValidationError + code_name() in PO-003 Kani harness with production crate::ValidationError + crate::diagnostic::error_code(). Harness uses #[kani::stub] on error_diagnostic_parts to eliminate format!() String allocation while preserving exact match logic. The stub function mirrors the same 58 match arms as production error_diagnostic_parts with DiagnosticCode::new(CONST) and String::new(). All 6 sub-harnesses verified passing (2.9-36.1s each).
impact: Stub replaces production format!() with empty String; does not change DiagnosticCode derivation. Stubbed function is private — callers unaffected.
compensating_evidence: proptest PO-017 tests production error_code() path at runtime (3/3 PASS). Kani harness now uses production ValidationError type.

description: REPAIR-9 (F-R8-001 PO-006 fix): Added symbolic_code_name() method to production YamlError in crates/vb_yaml/src/error.rs. Method maps each of 20 YamlError variants to a CODE_REGISTRY-registered symbolic name string. Kani harness updated to use production crate::YamlError::symbolic_code_name() instead of model enum + code_name(). Both sub-harnesses verified passing (6.0s, 10.4s).
impact: New method on public type; zero existing callers affected. Method is pure (no allocation, no I/O).
compensating_evidence: vb_yaml test suite 227/227 PASS. Kani 2/2 harnesses PASS. Code name strings verified against CODE_REGISTRY via is_registered_symbolic().

description: REPAIR-9: PO-003 harness uses #[kani::stub(crate::diagnostic::error_diagnostic_parts, stub_error_diagnostic_parts)]. Requires -Z stubbing flag. Stub function over-approximates by replacing format!() String allocation with String::new() (empty string). Does NOT change the DiagnosticCode values returned — the match arms are identical to production. Stub is harness-local (not stub_verified) — no contract proof required.
impact: Stubbing eliminates heap allocation overhead in Kani's CBMC backend. Over-approximation: stub returns empty String instead of format!() message. DiagnosticCode derivation unchanged.
compensating_evidence: Production error_code() discards the message String. The stub affects only the discarded value. All 6 sub-harnesses VERIFICATION SUCCESSFUL.
